cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import kit, encode

types = [
  {"name":"Bool","kind":"bool"},
  {"name":"St","kind":"enum","values":["S0","S1","S2","S3"]},
  {"name":"Msg","kind":"string","maxsize":8},
]
modules = [
  {"name":"m","params":[["st","St"],["msg","Msg"]],"result":["r","Bool"],"requires":None},
]
machine = {"states":["S0","S1","S2","S3"],"initial":"S0","state_param":"st","message_param":"msg",
 "transitions":[
   {"from":"S0","to":"S1","command":"b","cost":5,"when":None},
   {"from":"S0","to":"S1","command":"a","cost":3,"when":None},
   {"from":"S1","to":"S2","command":"c","cost":1,"when":None},
   {"from":"S0","to":"S2","command":"z","cost":10,"when":None},
   {"from":"S0","to":"S2","command":"y","cost":4,"when":None},
   {"from":"S0","to":"S2","command":"x","cost":4,"when":None},
   {"from":"S2","to":"S3","command":"d","cost":1,"when":["eq",["var","msg"],["const","Msg","go"]]},
   {"from":"S3","to":"S0","command":"loop","cost":1,"when":None},
 ]}
base = {"types":types,"modules":modules,"calls":[],"pipes":[],"entries":["m"],
        "machine":machine,"runs":[]}
plan = kit.run(base)["plans"][0]
print(json.dumps(plan))
m=modules[0]
def pad(s, n=8):
    b=[ord(c) for c in s]
    return b+[0]*(n-len(b))
def mk(st,msg,r):
    objs,n=encode.build(types,m,{"st":st,"msg":msg},r)
    assert n==plan["variables"],(n,plan["variables"])
    return kit.encode(objs)
runs=[
 {"entry":"m","ktest":mk("S0",pad("hi"),True)},      # initial: cost 0, commands ["hi"]
 {"entry":"m","ktest":mk("S2",pad("go"),True)},      # cost 4 commands [x, y?] -> ["x","go"]
 {"entry":"m","ktest":mk("S3",pad("go"),False)},     # cost 5 commands ["x","d","go"]
 {"entry":"m","ktest":mk("S3",pad("no"),False)},     # guard false -> UNREACHABLE
 {"entry":"m","ktest":mk("S1",pad("go"),True)},      # cost 3 commands ["a","go"]
 {"entry":"m","ktest":mk("S2",pad("go"),False)},     # duplicate of run 1
]
base["runs"]=runs
out=kit.run(base)
print(json.dumps(out["records"]))
for c in out["corpus"]: print(json.dumps(c))
PYEOF
